zh.title: 自動駕駛塞斯納Caravan完成3,199英里橫跨美國飛行
zh.summary: 改裝塞斯納Caravan無人操控飛行3,199英里橫跨美國
body: Simple Flying 報導，一架改裝的塞斯納 Caravan 完成了一趟歷史性飛行，航程達 3,199 英里橫跨美國，全程安全飛行員在機上未進行任何控制輸入。
該架飛機為改裝的塞斯納 Caravan，飛行距離約為 3,199 英里，根據報導，這趟飛行由自動駕駛系統完成，機上安全飛行員未進行任何控制輸入。
報導發布時間為2026年10月4日，目前尚未公佈確切的飛行日期、起降機場或營運者等細節。

en.title: Autonomous Cessna Caravan completes 3,199-mile US cross-country flight
en.summary: Modified Cessna Caravan flew 3,199 miles; no pilot control inputs
body: Simple Flying reported that a converted Cessna Caravan completed a historic flight, covering a distance of 3,199 miles across the US, with no control inputs made by the safety pilot on board.

The aircraft, a converted Cessna Caravan, flew a distance of approximately 3,199 miles. According to the report, this flight was performed with the safety pilot aboard but without any control inputs from that pilot.
Specific details such as the date of the flight, departure or arrival airports, or the operating company have not yet been reported.

zh.title: Catalina島醫療直升機墜海 兩死一失蹤
zh.summary: REACH醫療直升機墜海；兩死兩傷一失蹤；NTSB調查
body: 美國加州卡塔利娜島（Catalina Island）發生醫療直升機墜海事故。REACH Air Medical Services一架直升機於9月30日晚間約20:00前，自卡塔利娜島起飛後不久，在佩布利海灘（Pebbly Beach）附近墜入海中，機上載有五人。
救援人員從水中救起四人，其中兩人當場宣告死亡，另外兩人在穩定狀態下被送往大陸醫院。據洛杉磯縣消防局通報，失蹤者為當時正被運送的病人。
美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）已確認涉事直升機為Eurocopter EC135 P2，並表示正在調查；當局回報該機沉沒於約240英呎深的水中。REACH證實其中一架直升機涉入事故，並表示正在與應急人員及當局協調。

en.title: REACH medical helicopter crashes off Catalina Island; two killed, one missing
en.summary: REACH helicopter crashes off Catalina; two dead, one missing; NTSB investigating
body: A REACH Air Medical Services helicopter crashed into the ocean shortly after departing California's Catalina Island, killing two people and leaving another missing as of October 1, 2026. The incident occurred shortly before 20:00 local time on September 30 near Pebbly Beach, outside Avalon.

The helicopter was carrying five people on a medical transport flight to Los Angeles. Rescuers recovered four people from the water; two were pronounced dead at the scene, and two others were taken to mainland hospitals in stable condition, according to the Los Angeles County Fire Department. The missing person was the patient being transported from the island, said Coast Guard Cmdr. Mark Leahy.

The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) identified the helicopter as a Eurocopter EC135 P2 and noted that it was investigating. Authorities reported that the aircraft was submerged in approximately 240 feet of water. REACH confirmed that one of its helicopters was involved and said it was coordinating with emergency responders and authorities.
